basic_info.description: Love the freshness of new construction and the charm + character of a Victorian?  Look no further! This TIC flat combines both into one and was thoughtfully redesigned down to the studs just a few years ago. Located on the edge of Noe Valley & Mission Dolores, the home offers a blend of classic San Francisco charm and modern sophistication with a relaxed vibe in a perfect location. Positioned on a flat block of Dolores Street with just a few steps to the front door and all the goodness on one floor, this home defines easy living and low maintenance. Featuring an inviting and flexible floorplan, this residence includes 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, an office space, in-unit laundry, 1 car enclosed parking and an XL storage space. Enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance to local amenities, while reveling in the serene micro-climate and charming location.  Put yourself in one of the best neighborhoods with so much to see + do right out your front door.
